issues.description: PersonResource.getAllPersons() has an inconsistent return type between template and solution: the template defines `ResponseEntity<List<Person>>` for GET /persons, while the solution defines `ResponseEntity<java.util.Set<Person>>`. This changes the REST API contract (array order/duplicate semantics) compared to the template and can confuse students when implementing/consuming the endpoint.
issues.suggestedFix: Keep the endpoint contract consistent across repositories by changing the solution method signature back to `ResponseEntity<List<Person>>` (and returning `personService.getAll()`), or change the template accordingly and document the Set-based semantics.
